rules.requirement: Opaque identifiers begin with a letter, contain only the allowlisted characters, and are generated without embedding serials, paths, endpoints, credentials, email addresses, or IP addresses.
Provider dev.openeos.control must use semantic version 0.5.0 or newer.
target_size is allowed only for THUMBNAIL and PREVIEW.
When total_bytes is known, bytes_transferred is less than or equal to total_bytes.
For COMPLETED, received_byte_length equals bytes_transferred and equals total_bytes when total_bytes is known.
Only COMPLETED contains received_byte_length, transport_checksum_verified, and sanitized_evidence_id; only FAILED contains safe_error_code.
CANCEL_PENDING and CANCELLED require cancel_requested; CANCEL_PENDING must not be presented as terminal cancellation.
Only IMPORTED and DUPLICATE contain committed asset evidence and preserved representation IDs; only FAILED contains safe_error_code.
A receipt never authorizes deletion or mutation of camera media.
Exact duplicate decisions require SHA-256 or SHA-512 over FULL_ORIGINAL, or a full SHA-256 computed by the consumer after receiving all bytes.
